trust_decision.summary: Whether the stored Classic-portlet template and macro names may be interpreted as arbitrary TALES: decided at the render sink Renderer.path_expression(), which builds 'context/<template>[/macros/<macro>]' for python:path() in classic.pt, and at the template/macro fields of IClassicPortlet, which validates on add/edit forms and on GenericSetup import.

landing_point.why: An engineer reading 'RCE via TALES injection in the Classic portlet' opens the classic portlet module and finds path_expression() interpolating the user-supplied template/macro into a TALES path, which classic.pt then hands to python:path().

fix_sites.entry_point: Add/Edit Classic portlet forms (++contextportlets++<manager>/+/portlets.Classic and <mapping>/<name>/edit) and GenericSetup portlets.xml import (_initAssignmentNode -> field.validate)
fix_sites.module_kind: zope.schema data-provider interface field (form and serialization schema)

fix_sites.entry_point: Add/Edit Classic portlet forms and GenericSetup portlets.xml import, via the macro property
fix_sites.module_kind: zope.schema data-provider interface field (form and serialization schema)

fix_sites.entry_point: Renderer.render()/path_expression() reached by every portlet slot render, including @@render-portlet and @@manage-portlets

O3_reason_to_dismiss: GenericSetup portlets.xml (and the legacy left_slots migration in utils.py) is written by trusted site administrators or add-ons at setup time, not by the user who adds a portlet, so a solver can argue those inputs need no guard.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate template/macro names are traversal steps that contain '@', '-', '.' or '/': the existing render test uses template '@@view' with macro 'content-core', and path_expression tests use 'portlet_recent'. An over-broad alphanumeric-only guard rejects these and breaks the existing testRenderClassicPortlet render.

O6_input_shapes: template field (ASCIILine) carrying a TALES payload with the '|' fallback operator and a python: type, e.g. "x | python:'RCE'"; cited in fix.diff:82 and fix.diff:99
macro field (ASCIILine) carrying the same metacharacters in the second half of the generated path (only reached when use_macro() is true)
template-only assignment with macro empty or None, so only one interpolation happens (tests/test_classic_portlet.py:111-114 at the pinned commit)
assignments created programmatically, bypassing the add/edit form, e.g. by the GenericSetup importer or a direct classic.Assignment(template=..., macro=...)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Validate template/macro inside Assignment.__init__, the constructor every producer goes through
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer wanting one guard for form, import and migration paths would naturally validate where the attribute is set.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reject ':' and '|' in the left_slots path pieces while converting legacy portlets
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The migration splits an administrator-written traversal string and builds classic.Assignment(path[1], path[3]) from the pieces, so a check there looks like the obvious fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An explicit name whitelist next to field.validate during portlets.xml import
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The importer already validates every property before setting it, so a reviewer would add the name check in the same branch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second renderer template that calls python:path() with a differently built expression
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Custom renderers are registered from ZCML with any .pt file (metaconfigure.py:148-163), so another portlet template can copy the same pattern.

O9_family: CWE-95 eval injection: TALES expression injection through the Classic portlet template/macro names, leading to remote code execution

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools/setup.py (pyproject build-system), tox with zope.testrunner (tox.ini:84-87), Plone 6.2 / Zope 5, Python >=3.10
O10_build.project_tests: src/plone/app/portlets/tests/test_classic_portlet.py (TestPortlet, TestRenderer) on the plone.app.testing integration layer PLONE_APP_PORTLETS_INTEGRATION_TESTING (tests/base.py:14); other portlet tests in tests/test_*_portlet.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Guard only Renderer.path_expression() with a regex (or strip '|' and ':') and leave the two IClassicPortlet fields unconstrained, so GenericSetup imports and direct field.validate() still accept a TALES payload.
